title: Operational Planner
subtitle: AI-generated automation plan for the next day, with closed-loop scoring against the prior day's targets. Plans require operator Confirm to apply.

header.generateNotAllowed: Operators and admins can generate plans

scheduler.off: Scheduler off · enable in Settings to auto-generate plans nightly

consistency.title_one: Consistency warning ({{count}}) — the agent's prose disagrees with its structured data
consistency.title_other: Consistency warnings ({{count}}) — the agent's prose disagrees with its structured data
consistency.unknownAutomation: Prose references <mono>{{context}}</mono> but no live automation has id {{id}}.
consistency.untrackedAutomation: Prose discusses <mono>{{context}}</mono> but no diff entry touches automation #{{id}}.
consistency.timeRange: {{subject}} time range: prose says {{claimed}}, actual schedule spans {{actual}}
consistency.footer: The structured data (proposed_automations + changes_from_today) is the source of truth for Confirm. The prose is informational and may drift.

rejection.title: Rejected — operator feedback
rejection.footer: A new version of this plan was regenerated addressing this feedback.

discussion.title: Discussion
discussion.help: Ask the planner to explain a decision, or highlight something it may have missed. Conversation only — won't modify the plan unless you convert it to a regenerate.
discussion.confirmRegenerate_one: Convert {{count}} open clarification into a rejection feedback and regenerate the plan?
discussion.confirmRegenerate_other: Convert {{count}} open clarifications into a rejection feedback and regenerate the plan?
discussion.toastRegenerated: Plan rejected and regenerated from clarifications
discussion.applyOpenTitle: Bundle all open clarifications as rejection feedback and regenerate the plan
discussion.empty: No clarifications on this plan yet.
discussion.highlightHelp: You believe the plan missed something — planner will acknowledge and propose adjustments.
discussion.questionHelp: You want the planner to explain its reasoning — no plan change.
discussion.highlightPlaceholder: e.g. "VWC peaks at 60% on Sensor 1 during all 3 irrigations — too aggressive?"
discussion.questionPlaceholder: e.g. "Why 3 fertigation cycles instead of 2? What's the rationale for the 12:00 timing?"

toast.confirmedWithOverrides: Plan confirmed WITH guardrail overrides — recorded for audit.
toast.changesFailed_one: {{count}} change failed — see details on plan.
toast.changesFailed_other: {{count}} changes failed — see details on plan.
toast.feedbackRequired: Provide feedback so the planner can regenerate addressing your concerns.

confirm.replacePending: A pending plan already exists for tomorrow. Regenerate (replaces it)?
confirm.deletePlan: Delete this plan? Confirmed plans should NOT normally be deleted; this only removes the record, not the applied automations.

detail.selectPrompt: Select a plan or generate one for tomorrow.

raw.show: Show raw input snapshot & plan JSON
raw.hide: Hide raw input snapshot & plan JSON

confirmDialog.title: Apply this plan to live automations?
confirmDialog.body_one: Confirming plan {{date}} will INSERT {{add}}, UPDATE {{modify}} and DISABLE {{remove}} automation ({{keep}} kept unchanged). Guardrails are evaluated on apply.
confirmDialog.body_other: Confirming plan {{date}} will INSERT {{add}}, UPDATE {{modify}} and DISABLE {{remove}} automations ({{keep}} kept unchanged). Guardrails are evaluated on apply.

reject.title: Reject plan with feedback
reject.help: Describe what should change. The planner will regenerate addressing your feedback. Example: "You shifted irrigation too early — the morning dry-down is fine. Focus on the afternoon dip instead."
reject.placeholder: What did the plan miss or get wrong?

override.title: Guardrail override required
override.help: This plan would normally be blocked. Provide a written reason for each guardrail below to apply anyway. Reasons are recorded in the plan's audit trail.
override.adminRequired: One or more rules require admin-role override.
override.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Fresh AMIC just confirmed Ca at 195 mg/L — sample queue stale; applying tomorrow's plan as designed.
override.missingReasons_one: Provide a reason for {{count}} guardrail before applying
override.missingReasons_other: Provide a reason for {{count}} guardrails before applying

settings.title: Planner settings
settings.pendingNote: Scheduled plans are saved as <mono>pending</mono>. An operator must Confirm or Reject — the scheduler never auto-applies changes to live automations.

failure.headline_one: Plan generation has failed {{count}} day in a row since {{since}}
failure.headline_other: Plan generation has failed {{count}} days in a row since {{since}}

reason.credits: Anthropic API credits exhausted — top up at Plans & Billing

failure.retryNotAllowed: Operators and admins can retry generation
